qualifier: synthesis, PDE1 degradation and PKA activation
name: cAMP turnover and protein kinase A activation
rationale: All members concern cAMP synthesis, PDE-mediated breakdown and PKA activation downstream of GPCRs; unlike confusables it lacks adenylate cyclase-activating dopamine/CREB or adrenergic inhibitory arms and adds cAMP catabolism and PKA activation.

name: Liver X receptor-driven lipogenesis and triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members cover triglyceride synthesis and fatty acid/triglyceride homeostasis including LXR (NR1H2/3) lipogenic and lipolytic gene control, whereas confusables centre on lipid droplet dynamics, lipophagy and triglyceride catabolism.

name: Two-pore domain potassium channels setting resting membrane potential
rationale: Members are the K2P channel families (TWIK, TREK, TASK, TRESK, THIK) plus resting potential and ion-flux restraint, distinct from confusables built on Ca2+-activated, ATP-sensitive, TRP or TALK channels.

name: snRNA transcription and spliceosome assembly for mRNA splicing
rationale: Members span snRNA gene transcription by Pol II/III and spliceosome snRNP assembly and splice-site recognition, unlike confusables focused on nuclear RNA decay or Pol III tRNA/histone mRNA processing.

name: Centrosome, mitotic spindle and cytokinetic ring organization
rationale: Members concern centrosome/centriole control, microtubule nucleation and spindle positioning, cleavage furrow and contractile ring, versus confusables built on chromosome cohesion, condensation and nuclear envelope dynamics.

name: NGF–TRKA receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: All members are NGF/TRKA activation and its downstream FRS2, ARMS, PLC-gamma, ERK5, STAT3 and CREB outputs, distinguishing it from NTRK3 and p75NTR death-signalling confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF mutants and ERK negative feedback
name: Oncogenic RAF–MAPK signaling and ERK negative feedback
rationale: Members cover BRAF/RAF1 mutant and fusion signalling, MAP2K/MAPK activation and ERK dephosphorylation/feedback suppression, whereas confusables emphasise upstream RAS/MRAS-SHOC2 activation and RAS GAPs.

qualifier: sterol feedback on synthesis and LDL receptor uptake
name: Sterol feedback on cholesterol synthesis and lipoprotein receptor uptake
rationale: Members concern sterol sensing, SREBP control of cholesterol synthesis and LXR-driven limits on LDLR/VLDLR uptake, unlike confusables on generic receptor endocytosis/LDL clearance or HDL reverse cholesterol transport.

name: NOD1/NOD2 sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan
rationale: All members are NOD1/NOD2 signalling and responses to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide in antibacterial defence, distinct from C-type lectin, IL-17, TAK1/TLR and inflammasome confusables.

name: Amyloid fibril formation and amyloid precursor protein regulation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid fibril assembly and APP synthesis and catabolism, whereas confusables emphasise amyloid-beta clearance, glial activation and tangle assembly.

qualifier: disaccharide digestion and intestinal hexose transport
name: Intestinal disaccharide digestion and hexose absorption
rationale: Members cover brush-border disaccharidase digestion and its deficiencies with hexose/glycoside transport, unlike confusables centred on SLC transporter disease variants and renal solute handling.

qualifier: cardiac and skeletal cell size and hypertrophy
name: Cardiac and skeletal muscle hypertrophic growth and cell size
rationale: Members regulate cell size, cardiac adaptation, sarcomere organization and skeletal muscle growth, distinct from confusables on calcineurin-NFAT signalling or muscle atrophy and fiber-type switching.

qualifier: collagen, elastic and fibronectin fibres with integrins
name: Collagen, elastic and fibronectin fibre assembly with integrin binding
rationale: Members cover collagen trimerization and crosslinking, elastic and fibronectin fibre assembly and integrin/collagen-receptor interactions, whereas confusables emphasise laminins, proteoglycans and hemidesmosomes.

name: Hedgehog precursor autoprocessing, lipidation and release
rationale: Members describe Hedgehog autoproteolysis, HHAT palmitoylation, ERAD of mutants and Hh-Np release, distinct from Notch and Wnt ligand processing or generic protein lipidation.

name: Reproductive, parental and social behaviour with parturition
rationale: Members span mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behaviour, erection and insemination, parturition with uterine contraction and relaxin receptors, unlike confusables on sleep/wake, stress hormones or exploratory behaviour.

name: Dentin and cementum formation in tooth development
rationale: Members concern odontoblast differentiation, dentinogenesis, cementum mineralization and tooth eruption (with secreted-protein phosphorylation), distinct from enamel, bone mineralization and ectodermal appendage confusables.

name: T cell immunological synapse, adhesion and integrin-mediated migration
rationale: Members cover T cell surface signalling, immunological synapse and polarity, lymphocyte aggregation and integrin-dependent migration, unlike confusables centred on CD28-Vav1, Rho effectors or integrin activation alone.

qualifier: transcription and turnover in epithelial–mesenchymal transition
name: Cadherin transcription and turnover controlling epithelial–mesenchymal transition
rationale: Members regulate CDH1, CDH11 and CDH19 expression, trafficking and degradation alongside EMT control, whereas confusables focus on adherens junction assembly and cadherin-mediated adhesion itself.

name: RHOBTB atypical GTPases in protein stability and proteasomal turnover
rationale: Members combine protein (de)stabilization and positive regulation of proteasomal degradation with the RHOBTB1-3 cycles, distinguishing it from chaperonin, neddylation and deubiquitinase confusables.

name: Glycogen metabolism, glucose-6-phosphate handling and storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, breakdown and glycophagy, glycogen storage diseases and glucose-6-phosphate/glucokinase steps of gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables on glycolysis and fructose metabolism.

name: IL-6 signaling with ERK activation and phosphatase feedback
rationale: Members combine IL-6/JAK-STAT3 signalling with ERK1/2 activation and dephosphorylation-based negative feedback, distinct from confusables on IL-27/35, JNK/AP-1 or generic ERK serine phosphorylation.

name: Branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase and maple syrup urine disease
rationale: All members concern BCKDH activity, its kinase/phosphatase regulation and MSUD-causing defects, unlike confusables on downstream leucine/valine catabolism and organic acidemias.

qualifier: hydroxylation, oxidation and methylation with collagen crosslinking
name: Protein hydroxylation, oxidation and methylation including collagen crosslinking
rationale: Members cover lysine/proline hydroxylation, protein oxidation (collagen crosslinking, arylsulfatase activation) and methylation, unlike confusables on translation-factor and tRNA modifications.

name: Amyloid-beta production, clearance and cellular response
rationale: Members regulate amyloid-beta formation, clearance, fibril formation and cellular response with tangle assembly, distinct from confusables on glial activation or fibril formation without clearance.

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly opposing epithelial–mesenchymal transition
rationale: Members cover cadherin adhesion, adherens/apical junction assembly, apical constriction and EMT restraint, whereas confusables emphasise apicobasal polarity, desmosomes or specific cadherin gene regulation.
